notes.title: Get an extra bag of Eldrador® Mini Creatures from Schleich®
notes.notes:
[h2]Get an extra bag of Eldrador® Mini Creatures from Schleich®  for Eldrador® Creatures - the video game![/h2]

You can always make use of a few extra Eldrador® Mini Creatures to complete the arenas in Eldrador® Creatures – and we would like to give you an extra bag.

The only thing you need to do is to solve the jigsaw puzzle below to obtain the secret code for unlocking  the extra bag of Eldrador® Mini Creatures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39005216/c341598e893e64d762241cc93127c5d075cab75a.png[/img]

[h3]How to make use of the secret code:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Start Eldrador® Creatures
[*] Click ‘Settings’
[*] Click ‘Secret code’
[*] Enter the six digit code
[/list]

notes.title: Eldrador® Creatures out now
notes.notes:
[h2]Go on a fantastic adventure journey through lava, ice, stone and jungle.[/h2]

The mystical Schleich® theme world of the same name comes to life in this turn-based strategy game, in which powerful mythical creatures fight against each other for the super weapon; a magical sword that is supposed to give them and their world great power.

You choose which of the four factions you would like to lead to victory in strategic battles through the different worlds of Eldrador.

Each being from Eldrador has its own strengths and weaknesses. You have to devise strategies on which character to use and how to achieve your goal.

You will meet the well-known original Schleich® creatures – even characters that will not appear as figures until 2021 are part of the game.
